name: sessions-panel-mod
description: A side pane that lists your Claude Code sessions and what each one is doing: waiting for your reply, working now, finished recently, or gone quiet. Click a card to jump to that session in the desktop app. It is a mod for Claude Code and the Claude desktop app's Code tab.

plugins.name: recent-sessions
plugins.description: A side pane listing your Claude Code sessions, with a click to open any of them in the desktop app.
